value.rationale: The problem directly controls two obvious confounders in ecological comparisons (same richness and same total abundance) and asks the first precise census where Shannon and maximum dominance concur but inverse Simpson reverses. This natural three-order ranking problem has a sharp minimum, singleton boundary class and necessarily two crossings, not a reparameterization of general profile-crossing existence.
